readout_other: CARS; ABC; ATEC; SRS; RBS-R; resting-state fNIRS functional connectivity
direction_notes: Scale scores for autism symptoms fell over four weeks and resting-state fNIRS functional connectivity increased; the authors describe the protocol as previously inhibitory for MEP amplitudes.
safety_notes: The boy completed every session and reported no discomfort such as headache, fatigue or muscle twitching.

timing.protocol_description: Pulse width T1 = 400, pulse repetition period T2 = 25 ms (PRF 40 Hz), burst duration T3 = 500 ms, burst period T4 = 2 s, duty cycle 1.6%; 30 minutes per session on each weekday for four weeks (20 sessions).

source_quotes.n_subjects: We describe the application of transcranial focused ultrasound to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex in a boy with ASD, which was applied for 30 minutes each consecutive weekday for four weeks (20 sessions in total).

flags.reason: Pulse width T1 stated as 400 ms alongside T2 = 25 ms and DC 1.6% (T1/T2); the unit is probably a typo (microseconds); recorded as written.
Burst duration T3 = 500 ms repeating every T4 = 2 s for 30 min; recorded the 0.5 s burst; nested structure.
Stated as 113.47 mW/cm2, converted to 0.11347 W/cm2; domain not stated.
ISPPA 28.37 W/cm2 given without stating the domain.
Transducer maker is not named; the stimulation system maker is GreenValley BrainTech.
Case report of one boy; the authors mention three further participants in an ongoing trial.
Authors say the protocol inhibited MEP amplitudes in TMS testing; the paper does not report excitation or inhibition for this participant.
